import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:restage/restage.dart';

/// A branded badge.
@RestageWidget()
class AcmeBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  const AcmeBadge({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => const Text('Shared badge');
}

/// A locally painted mark.
@RestageWidget()
class AcmeMark extends StatelessWidget {
  const AcmeMark({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CustomPaint(painter: _MarkPainter());
}

class _MarkPainter extends CustomPainter {
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {}

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

Widget acmeTitle(String title) => Text(title);

class AcmeHelpers {
  static Widget action(VoidCallback onPressed) => FilledButton(
        onPressed: onPressed,
        child: const Text('Continue'),
      );
}
